description: This file is a Python source code module that handles dynamic loading of user-defined secret manager classes for the litellm project. It includes functions to load, validate, instantiate, and set custom secret managers based on configuration files.

classes.name: CustomSecretManager
classes.description: Base class for custom secret managers, imported from litellm.integrations.custom_secret_manager.

methods.name: load_custom_secret_manager
methods.description: Loads and initializes a custom secret manager class from a specified Python file, validating its subclass status, and sets it as the active secret manager in the litellm framework.
